content: OWUI web search enabled via env: ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=True, WEB_SEARCH_ENGINE=searxng, SEARXNG_QUERY_URL=http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>, WEB_SEARCH_RESULT_COUNT, WEB_SEARCH_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS. Older alias ENABLE_RAG_WEB_SEARCH/RAG_WEB_SEARCH_ENGINE churns across versions. ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG: once a ConfigVar is set via Admin UI the DB value takes precedence over env on subsequent boots; env baked on first boot.
